info.name: Daylist API v1
info.description:
Daylist API on your Mac (make up, then http://localhost:8080).

1. Run Auth > POST /auth/login (demo@daylist.test / password123 after `make fresh`). The token is saved for every other request.
2. Run Lists > GET /lists or POST /lists: list_id is saved. Creating a task, step, group, attachment or invite saves its id too.
3. Change base_url in the collection Variables tab if you use another port or your Mac's IP from an iPhone.
Smart-list requests send today={{today}}, set automatically to your Mac's date.

exec: // Your Mac's local date, sent as ?today= so My Day matches your day.
